sourceSpec: Master feature checklist (98 sections), mapped to DiagramHQ. CLI named 'dhq'. Name locked as DiagramHQ; spec's 'SystemAtlas' was its placeholder.

legend.featureRule: Exactly one feature across the whole file is 'active' at a time. A feature is 'passed' only when every acceptance item is met AND its 'test' passes AND evidence is recorded. Do not start a feature whose dependsOn are not all 'passed'.
legend.phaseRule: Phases are gated and built in order (P1..P6). A phase's features may not go 'active' until the previous phase's testGate has passed. Each phase must be fully implemented AND tested (its testGate) before the next begins.

fields.spec: section number(s) in the master checklist this feature covers
fields.test: the specific test that must pass for this feature
fields.evidence: reproducible command/output or artifact path; null until passed

phases.name: Core product
phases.goal: The fundamental IcePanel-class experience: a versioned, tenant-isolated architecture model with objects, connections, an infinite canvas, C4 drill-down, diagrams-as-views, metadata, search, save/load, undo/redo, auto-layout and export.
phases.headlineFlow: Model a system top-to-bottom (context -> container -> component), lay it out, inspect and edit metadata, save, reload, and export a PNG.
phases.testGate: Every feature in this phase is 'passed' with recorded evidence; an end-to-end smoke test of the headline flow is green; check-architecture is clean; a short demo is captured under .harness/evidence/<phase>/. The next phase does not start until this gate passes.

features.title: Monorepo scaffold + clean baseline
acceptance: pnpm workspace: apps/web (Next.js App Router), apps/api (NestJS), packages/domain (framework-free), packages/config
typecheck, lint, and a trivial test pass across the workspace
init script runs green from a clean clone
CLAUDE.md command table updated with real install/dev/typecheck/lint/test commands
features.test: init + pnpm typecheck/lint/test green from a clean clone; check-architecture runs

features.title: Core model, tenancy & versioning schema
acceptance: Prisma schema: organizations, workspaces, architectures, versions (live + immutable numbered), model_objects, model_connections, tags, technologies, views, view_objects (DATA_MODEL.md)
Tenant isolation enforced at the query layer (org+workspace scoping)
Object lifecycle states: future, live, deprecated, removed
Domain invariants live in packages/domain as pure functions
features.test: Migration applies to a fresh Postgres; test round-trips an entity; a cross-tenant read is denied by test

features.title: Object-type catalog + hierarchy
acceptance: Object-type registry seeded with the full catalog: person, actor, system, external-system, application, service, component, database, cache, queue, topic, bucket, api, function, server, container, k8s-workload, cloud-resource, load-balancer, gateway, group, boundary
Parent/child nesting with cycle prevention
Adding a new type is a registration, not a core edit (MODULES.md)
features.test: Unit test: each built-in type registered; nesting rejects a cycle; a new type added via the registry appears with no core change

features.title: Object CRUD API
acceptance: GET/POST /architectures/:id/objects, GET/PATCH/DELETE /objects/:id
Request validation at the edge, invariant checks in domain
Delete cascades connections + view_objects, never other objects
features.test: Integration test: create -> read -> update -> delete

features.title: First-class connections + properties
acceptance: Connection is an entity with source/dest/protocol/technology/direction/data-type/auth/encryption/status/owner/tags/api/port/frequency/latency/error-behavior
Connection types: HTTP, HTTPS, REST, GraphQL, gRPC, WebSocket, TCP, UDP, Kafka, Event, Queue, Database, File, Internal, External
Source and target validated to exist in the same architecture + version
features.test: Integration test: create with properties; invalid endpoint rejected

features.title: Infinite canvas renders the model
acceptance: React Flow behind a CanvasRenderer interface (ADR-0002, MODULES.md §7)
Objects + connections fetched via TanStack Query render as nodes/edges
Infinite pan + zoom + minimap
Canvas holds no domain data in Zustand (layer-boundaries rule 4)
features.test: pnpm test (canvas + command layer) + screenshot of a rendered model

features.title: Full canvas interaction set
acceptance: zoom, pan, drag, multi-select, box-select, snap-to-grid, align, distribute, copy, paste, duplicate, delete, lock, hide, group, ungroup, collapse, expand, minimap, fullscreen, focus mode
Positions persist to view_objects (per-view layout)
Canvas mutates only through the client-model command layer (layer-boundaries rule 3)
features.test: Component tests for select/drag/group/distribute; screenshot of minimap + focus mode

features.title: Canvas toolbar
acceptance: Toolbar: select, pan, object, connection, group, boundary, text, note, comment(stub), search, AI(stub)
Tool switching + keyboard binding
Creating via object/connection/boundary tools works
features.test: Each tool activates; object/connection/boundary creation via toolbar works

features.title: Create objects and connect them on canvas
acceptance: Create an object of each built-in kind from the canvas/palette
Draw a connection between two objects; it persists via the connection API
Optimistic update with rollback on API error
features.test: Create each kind; connect two; simulated API error rolls back

features.title: Smart connection routing
acceptance: Routing modes: straight, orthogonal, curved, automatic, manual
Auto routing minimizes crossings
Manual override persists
features.test: Routing modes render; crossing count reduced vs a naive layout on a sample graph

features.title: Auto-layout engines
acceptance: Layout-engine registry: hierarchical, tree, force-directed, layered, radial, grid, left-to-right, top-to-bottom
Apply-layout arranges without overlaps and persists positions
Manual positions preserved unless layout is re-applied
features.test: Each engine lays out a sample without overlap (assert bbox non-overlap)

features.title: C4 drill-down navigation
acceptance: Double-click a system drills to its containers; a container to its components; a component toward code (L4 stub)
Breadcrumb reflects the current level; navigation is over the model, not separate files
Back/up returns to the parent level
features.test: Double-click drills a level; breadcrumb + back verified

features.title: Diagrams as views over the model
acceptance: A diagram is a saved view (filter/set + layout), never a store of objects
Diagram types: system-context, container, component
The same object appears in multiple diagrams; create/open/rename diagrams
features.test: Add an object to two diagrams; delete from one leaves it in the other and in the model

features.title: Object inspector + full metadata + lifecycle
acceptance: Inspector shows/edits name, description, caption, type, owner, team, technology, status, environment, domain, tags, links, repository, documentation, criticality, data-classification, compliance, cost-center, SLA, RTO, RPO, version, created, updated
Lifecycle transitions: future -> live -> deprecated -> removed
Inspector sections come from the object-type registry
features.test: Edit persists via API + reflects on canvas; a lifecycle transition is recorded

features.title: Global search (Cmd+K)
acceptance: Search across objects, tags, technologies (P1 scope; flows/ADRs/docs join later)
Fuzzy matching; results grouped by kind
Cmd+K opens; jump-to selects and centers the object on canvas
features.test: Search returns matching objects; jump centers the node

features.title: Command palette actions
acceptance: Cmd+K palette: create system/service/database/connection, connect objects, generate diagram, search, open docs, export, share
Actions dispatch through the client-model command layer
Fuzzy search over objects in the current architecture
features.test: Representative actions execute via the palette

features.title: Undo / redo
acceptance: Command layer records reversible commands; Cmd+Z / Cmd+Shift+Z
Covers create, connect, move, delete, metadata edit
History is per-session UI state, not persisted model data
features.test: Undo/redo across all covered ops verified

features.title: Save / load / autosave
acceptance: Model persists server-side; debounced autosave
Reload restores model + per-view layout
Optimistic writes with rollback
features.test: Create -> reload -> identical model; simulated API error rolls back

features.title: Export PNG / SVG
acceptance: Export current diagram/view to PNG and SVG (exporter registry)
Fidelity matches the canvas; large graphs handled
features.test: Export a sample view; assert file produced + non-empty; visual check screenshot

features.title: Keyboard shortcuts
acceptance: Cmd+K palette, / search, Space pan, Delete, Cmd+Z / Cmd+Shift+Z, Cmd+C/V/D, F fit, 1/2/3 view levels
features.test: Each shortcut triggers its action (keymap unit test + a few e2e)

features.title: Minimal auth + tenant isolation
acceptance: A single auth provider gates the app (decide Auth.js/Clerk/WorkOS; note the ADR)
All model reads/writes scoped to the user's org + workspace
Owner/editor/viewer check; no cross-tenant access
features.test: Unauthorized denied; cross-tenant read denied; role check on write

phases.name: Collaboration
phases.goal: Turn the single-player model into a team tool: users, teams, roles/permissions, comments, mentions, real-time editing, share links, version history and notifications.
phases.headlineFlow: Two users collaborate live on one architecture with roles enforced, comment and @mention, snapshot a version, and share a read-only link.
phases.testGate: Every feature in this phase is 'passed' with recorded evidence; an end-to-end smoke test of the headline flow is green; check-architecture is clean; a short demo is captured under .harness/evidence/<phase>/. The next phase does not start until this gate passes.

features.title: Users, teams, members + ownership
acceptance: Org members; teams; object ownership (owner + backup team)
'Show everything owned by X' query
features.test: Assign owner; filter by owner returns exactly the owned set

features.title: Roles & permissions (RBAC)
acceptance: Roles: organization-owner, admin, architect, engineer, reviewer, viewer, guest
Permission checks on every mutation; engineer scoped to assigned systems
features.test: Role permission matrix test: each role's allowed/denied actions enforced

features.title: Comments
acceptance: Comments on objects, connections, diagrams, flows, documentation, architecture changes
Reply, resolve
features.test: Comment CRUD + resolve; attached to the correct entity

features.title: Mentions & tasks
acceptance: @mention notifies the user; convert a comment into a task
features.test: Mention creates a notification; task created from a comment

features.title: Real-time editing + presence
acceptance: Multiple users edit live; cursors, selection, current-object, presence
Conflict resolution (CRDT/OT)
features.test: Two clients: an edit in one appears in the other; presence shows both

features.title: Share links (read-only)
acceptance: Generate a read-only link that preserves viewer position + selection
Viewable without an account
features.test: Open the link in an anonymous context; state is preserved

features.title: Version history & snapshots
acceptance: Live editable version + immutable numbered snapshots
A snapshot captures objects, connections, views, flows, metadata, documentation
Restore / compare versions
features.test: Snapshot v1.0; edit live; snapshot stays immutable; diff shows the changes

features.title: Notifications
acceptance: In-app notifications for changes, comments, mentions, review requests
Email + Slack + Microsoft Teams channels (config)
features.test: An event produces a notification; channel dispatch tested (stubbed transport)

phases.name: Architecture intelligence
phases.goal: Make the model useful for engineering decisions: dynamic views, flows, domains, technology catalog, ADRs, dependency graph, impact/SPOF/blast-radius, failure simulation, security view, data lineage, rules+linting, health, catalogs, branches/PRs/diff, scenarios/roadmap, templates and documentation.
phases.headlineFlow: Filter to a security view, trace a PII data-lineage path, run impact analysis + failure simulation, lint against rules, and open an architecture PR with a diff.
phases.testGate: Every feature in this phase is 'passed' with recorded evidence; an end-to-end smoke test of the headline flow is green; check-architecture is clean; a short demo is captured under .harness/evidence/<phase>/. The next phase does not start until this gate passes.

features.title: Dynamic filtered views
acceptance: Filter the model by team, technology, environment, domain, owner, status, tag, criticality, data-classification, cloud-provider, region, repository
A view is a stored filter that stays live as the model changes
features.test: Filter by team returns exactly the matching objects; adding a matching object updates the view

features.title: Saved views & persona modes
acceptance: Save/star named views (executive, security, payments, AWS, data, production...)
Persona modes over one model: architect, developer, security, SRE, data, product, executive, auditor
features.test: Save a view; switching persona re-scopes the render without changing the model

features.title: Flow system
acceptance: A flow is an ordered sequence of existing connections (not a static line)
Flow types: user-journey, API-request, data, authentication, payment, checkout, event, background-job, batch, disaster-recovery, security
Create/edit ordered steps
features.test: Build a flow from connections; steps ordered; an invalid step is rejected

features.title: Flow playback
acceptance: Controls: play, pause, next, previous, speed, restart
Animates steps in order over the model
features.test: Playback advances the step index; controls work (component test)

features.title: Domains / bounded contexts
acceptance: DDD domains group objects; nested domains; assign objects to a domain
features.test: Assign an object to a domain; filter by domain returns the set

features.title: Technology catalog + lifecycle
acceptance: Technology library: name, category, version, vendor, lifecycle, security-status, owner, documentation
Lifecycle states; 'find systems using unsupported technology'
features.test: Tag objects with a technology; query for unsupported returns them

features.title: ADR system
acceptance: ADR: title, status, context, decision, consequences, alternatives
Attach to objects, connections, changes, versions; history shown on an object
features.test: Create an ADR, link it to an object, and see it in the object's history

features.title: Dependency graph view
acceptance: Dedicated dependency-graph screen
Filters: direct, indirect, runtime, compile-time, data, external
features.test: Graph renders dependencies; each filter narrows correctly

features.title: Circular deps, SPOF & blast radius
acceptance: Detect circular dependencies
Detect single points of failure
Blast-radius counts: services, flows, databases, teams, customer-facing features
features.test: Seeded cycle detected; SPOF flagged on a fan-in; blast-radius counts correct

features.title: Impact analysis
acceptance: Select an object -> direct + indirect dependencies, affected flows/teams/APIs, critical paths
features.test: Impact of deleting a node matches the expected dependency + path sets

features.title: Failure simulation
acceptance: Mark an object down; highlight the blast radius with severity
Count dependent requests/flows; distinguish fallback vs no-fallback
features.test: Simulate a DB outage; downstream flagged; fallback vs no-fallback distinguished

features.title: Security view + data classification
acceptance: Overlay trust boundaries, public endpoints, authentication, authorization, encryption, secrets, PII, PCI, HIPAA, SOC2
Data classification on objects + flows: public, internal, confidential, restricted, PII, PHI, PCI, secrets, financial
features.test: Classify data; the security view renders boundaries and flags public endpoints

features.title: Data lineage
acceptance: Trace a data element across objects and flows
'Where does <data> leave our infrastructure?'
features.test: Lineage of a field returns the ordered path including the external exit point

features.title: Architecture rules + linting
acceptance: Org-defined rules (owner required, external API auth, no cross-service DB access, PII flow restrictions)
Lint with error / warning / info findings
features.test: Seeded violations produce the expected lint findings; a compliant model is clean

features.title: Architecture health + analytics
acceptance: Categorized health (dependencies, documentation, security, ownership, drift) with concrete findings
Analytics counts (systems, apps, components, dbs, external deps, teams, flows, decisions) + change analytics
features.test: Health computed on a sample; findings match the seeded gaps

features.title: API / event / database catalogs
acceptance: API catalog: endpoints linked to service + repo
Event catalog: producer, consumers, schema, topic, frequency
Database catalog: schema/table/column (model-driven; imports in P5)
features.test: Create API/event/db entries, link to objects, and browse the catalogs

features.title: Branches, changes, diff & PRs
acceptance: Architecture branches off main
Architecture change/PR: added/modified/removed + affected counts (objects, flows, teams)
Diff view (added/modified/removed/moved colors); review, comment, approve, reject, merge
features.test: Branch; make changes; the PR shows the correct diff; merge applies to main

features.title: Scenarios & roadmap
acceptance: Hypothetical scenarios (current vs proposed) without touching the real model
Roadmap items linked to architecture changes
features.test: Create a scenario, compare it; a roadmap item links to a change

features.title: Architecture templates
acceptance: Templates: SaaS, e-commerce, fintech, banking, healthcare, microservices, monolith, serverless, event-driven, data-platform, AI-platform, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, GCP
Instantiate a template into a new architecture
features.test: Instantiate a template; the expected objects/connections are created

features.title: Documentation editor + pages
acceptance: Every object renders to a documentation page
Editor: markdown, rich text, images, architecture embeds, diagrams, tables, code blocks, links, mentions, comments
Architecture documentation tree
features.test: Edit a doc, embed a diagram; it renders correctly

features.title: REST API surface (intelligence resources)
acceptance: REST endpoints for views, flows, domains, technologies, decisions, branches, changes
Consistent auth + pagination + typed errors
features.test: Contract tests for the new resource endpoints

phases.name: AI
phases.goal: AI as a first-class surface: grounded Copilot, the AI command set, NL generation and editing with evidence, AI documentation, a review agent, AI analysis, an MCP tool server and specialized agents.
phases.headlineFlow: Ask the Copilot a grounded question, generate + NL-edit architecture as approved changesets with evidence, and have the review agent gate a PR; drive it all via MCP.
phases.testGate: Every feature in this phase is 'passed' with recorded evidence; an end-to-end smoke test of the headline flow is green; check-architecture is clean; a short demo is captured under .harness/evidence/<phase>/. The next phase does not start until this gate passes.

features.title: Architecture Copilot panel
acceptance: Persistent right-side panel; grounded Q&A over the model
Answers cite the object ids they are grounded in
features.test: Ask 'why does X depend on Y'; the answer references the real connection

features.title: AI command set
acceptance: explain, generate, modify, find-dependencies, find-bottlenecks, find-SPOF, find-security-issues, find-unused, find-duplicated, find-circular, find-external, find-PII-paths, find-critical-paths, generate-docs, generate-ADR, generate-diagram, generate-flow, compare-versions, review-change, estimate-impact
features.test: A representative subset returns correct grounded results against a seeded model

features.title: AI architecture generation (NL)
acceptance: NL prompt -> objects, connections, descriptions, technologies, tags, flows, diagrams, documentation as a proposed changeset
features.test: A prompt generates a changeset; applying it yields a valid model

features.title: Natural-language editing
acceptance: NL edit -> explicit proposed changes (added/modified/removed) with Apply / Reject
Never silently modifies the architecture
features.test: 'Add Redis between A and B' proposes exactly those changes; Reject leaves the model unchanged

features.title: AI evidence + confidence
acceptance: Every AI assertion/edit carries evidence (repository/file/line where applicable) + a confidence score
features.test: A generated dependency includes evidence fields; low-confidence items are flagged

features.title: AI documentation generation
acceptance: Auto-generate object + architecture documentation grounded in metadata and connections
Keeps documentation current on change
features.test: Generate docs for a service; content is grounded in its metadata + connections

features.title: Architecture review agent
acceptance: Pre-merge review: no circular dependency, all services have owners, no unapproved external dependency, backup policy, DR, no PII to unapproved third parties
Request-changes verdict
features.test: Seeded violations produce the expected review verdict on a PR

features.title: AI impact / security / bottleneck analysis
acceptance: AI narratives layered over impact-analysis, failure-simulation, and security-view results
features.test: The AI explanation matches the computed impact set

features.title: MCP tool server
acceptance: Expose: search_architecture, get_object, create_object, update_object, delete_object, get_dependencies, get_dependents, analyze_impact, create_diagram, create_flow, compare_versions, create_change, review_change, create_adr
Mutating tools return a proposed change (approval required), never a silent commit
features.test: Each tool is callable; create_object returns a proposal, not a silent commit

features.title: Specialized architecture agents
acceptance: Analyst, Designer, Security, Cloud, Documentation, Migration, Code agents built on the MCP surface
features.test: Each agent completes a scoped task against a sample model

phases.name: Code & infrastructure intelligence
phases.goal: Close the code -> architecture loop: GitHub/GitLab, OpenAPI, Terraform, Kubernetes, AWS/Azure/GCP import with evidence, code mapping, drift detection, cost, model-as-code + CLI, webhooks, SDK and a public portal.
phases.headlineFlow: Connect a repo + IaC, generate/refresh the model with evidence, detect drift and open a change request, and push/pull via the CLI.
phases.testGate: Every feature in this phase is 'passed' with recorded evidence; an end-to-end smoke test of the headline flow is green; check-architecture is clean; a short demo is captured under .harness/evidence/<phase>/. The next phase does not start until this gate passes.

features.title: GitHub integration + code mapping
acceptance: Connect a repo; detect services, APIs, databases, queues, dependencies, libraries, frameworks, cloud SDKs
Map component -> repository -> folder -> file; open-in-GitHub
Every detected object/connection carries evidence
features.test: Scan a sample repo; the expected objects are proposed with evidence

features.title: GitLab integration
acceptance: Same detection + mapping as GitHub for GitLab repos
features.test: Scan a sample GitLab repo; parity with the GitHub importer

features.title: OpenAPI import -> API catalog
acceptance: Import an OpenAPI spec; endpoints populate the API catalog and link to a service
features.test: Import a spec; endpoints appear in the catalog linked to the right service

features.title: Terraform integration
acceptance: Parse Terraform; map aws_instance, aws_db_instance, aws_s3_bucket, aws_lambda_function, aws_sqs_queue, etc. to objects
features.test: Parse sample Terraform; the expected resources are mapped

features.title: Kubernetes integration
acceptance: Import cluster, namespace, deployment, statefulset, pod, service, ingress, configmap, secret, persistentvolume, job, cronjob
Render the namespace topology
features.test: Import sample manifests; the topology renders

features.title: AWS import
acceptance: Import EC2, ECS, EKS, Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, S3, CloudFront, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, VPC as objects
features.test: Import a mocked account; resources are mapped to objects

features.title: Azure & GCP import
acceptance: Equivalent resource import for Azure and GCP
features.test: Import mocked Azure + GCP resources; mapped to objects

features.title: Architecture drift detection
acceptance: Compare the documented model against imported/actual state; surface the delta
Actions: Update Model, Ignore, Create Change Request
features.test: Seeded drift is detected; Create-Change-Request produces a PR

features.title: Cost visualization
acceptance: Attach cloud cost to infrastructure objects; per-service rollup (compute/database/storage/networking)
features.test: Mocked cost data rolls up correctly per service

features.title: Model-as-code + CLI
acceptance: YAML model maps to objects + connections by slug -> stable id
CLI: dhq login, init, pull, push, validate, diff, deploy, export, generate
push then pull round-trips the file
features.test: push YAML -> model; pull -> equivalent YAML; validate catches errors

features.title: Webhooks
acceptance: Emit object.created/updated/deleted, connection.created/updated, diagram.created, flow.created, architecture.updated, version.created, change.approved, change.merged
features.test: An action fires the expected webhook (captured by a test sink)

features.title: SDK (TypeScript first)
acceptance: Typed TS SDK over the REST API (Python/Go/Java/C# later)
features.test: SDK CRUD round-trip against a test server

features.title: Public architecture portal
acceptance: Publish a read-only site: search, zoom, navigate, drill-down, flows, documentation, objects, dependencies
No account required to view
features.test: Publish; an anonymous visitor can browse and drill down

phases.name: Enterprise
phases.goal: Enterprise readiness: SSO, SCIM, advanced RBAC + org policies, audit log, compliance packs, governance, private deployment, billing, marketplace and mobile.
phases.headlineFlow: SSO + SCIM + RBAC + audit in place, a compliance pack mapped with evidence, a private-deployment smoke test, and billing tier gates enforced.
phases.testGate: Every feature in this phase is 'passed' with recorded evidence; an end-to-end smoke test of the headline flow is green; check-architecture is clean; a short demo is captured under .harness/evidence/<phase>/. The next phase does not start until this gate passes.

features.title: SSO (SAML / OAuth)
